channel.title: Salt Lake Tribune - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Salt Lake Tribune (sltrib.com)

item.title: Voices: Utah lawmakers aren’t listening to Gen Z. We need to hold them accountable.
item.description: “My future should not be held in the hands of a system that does not represent me,” writes Aaliyah Henderson in an op-ed. “That is why it is important for young voices to be heard and for Gen Z to be civically engaged.”

item.title: Letter: Utah’s anti-masking bill wouldn’t suppress peaceful assembly. Its aim is legitimate.
item.description: Letter: Wearing masks lowers inhibitions and makes it easier for bad actors to do wrong. That’s why protestors should not be allowed to wear them. Whether ICE agents wear them is irrelevant.

item.title: Utah shuts down Safe and Sound Services after 3 disabled men die in van left running in garage
item.description: Utah licensing officials shut down Safe and Sound Services, citing repeated health and safety violations.

item.title: After Nevada rejected it, some want Utah to take on the nation’s nuclear waste
item.description: The U.S. is looking for a nuclear waste site. One Utah county could be in the mix. Supporters see jobs and investment. But some locals worry about becoming the nation’s dumping ground.

item.title: Northern Corridor construction must hit the brakes, a federal judge rules
item.description: Construction activities must stop on the controversial Northern Corridor highway through critical Mojave desert tortoise habitat in southern Utah, a federal judge ordered this week.

item.title: Mike Lee and Utah’s GOP delegation move to scrap Biden’s plan for one of the state’s most contested national monuments
item.description: Utah leaders are trying to overturn the Biden-era plan for Grand Staircase-Escalante National Monument using the Congressional Review Act.

item.title: A ‘slam dunk’ development near Park City still isn’t finished, and people are suing
item.description: A contractor says they haven’t been paid, and a would-be owner wants his six-figure deposit back, as a Park City condo-hotel initially slated to open years ago remains under construction.

item.title: Rep. Burgess Owens won’t seek reelection to Congress this fall
item.description: Utah's U.S. Rep. Burgess Owens will not run for reelection in this year's midterm elections.

item.title: Letter: If you support voting by mail, you better let your Utah legislator know today
item.description: Letter: Lannie Chapman and Deidre Henderson are two very strong advocates in government for us. Where do your state representative and senator stand? Call them and find out.

item.title: Rep. Trevor Lee says Trump wants immigration restrictions passed. No senator is backing the bill.
item.description: While Rep. Trevor Lee says the Trump administration wants a piece of immigration legislation to move forward in Utah, no senator is yet willing to sponsor it.
